prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A small ink glyph — a single horizontal line broken in the middle by an
upward-arrow notch, symbolizing crossing a threshold. Ember ink, urgent.

formatted_prompt.scene: Ink and watercolor field-journal plate, a single threshold glyph centered on aged parchment, ember orange punctuating warm vellum cream.

subjects.description: Horizontal line broken at center by a sharp upward-arrow notch; bold nib-pen strokes, minimal and urgent, high-contrast silhouette readable at icon scale.
Aged vellum surface, faint foxing at edges, subtle grain texture beneath the glyph.
